format: questions: {<allowed patch path>: {id, text (Russian, rendered as the question above the buttons), hint (English: when the engine should ask it), choices: [{label (button), value (patch value), chip (Russian chip text when the engine assumes this value instead of asking)}], recommend: {from: [profile|pattern], default}}}. Answering patches the field with the chosen value (source user). The recommended choice is the first available of: the profile value, the insights pattern value (stage 5), then `default` (null: no recommendation). Choice values are valid for the field's patch schema. For party.children_ages a value is one representative age per bucket; exact ages arrive at checkout. place_confirm: the photo confirmation question (AGENT_PLAN Foundation decision 3) for 0.5 <= image.place.confidence < 0.8; {place} is the recognised place name, the yes-choice patches destination.name with it, the no-choice patches nothing (traits only).

party.segment.hint: Ask when the segment is unknown and the variants differ by segment (hotel kind, district, rooms). Otherwise assume from the profile and show a chip.

origin.city.hint: Ask only when the profile has no home city; the default changes every price.

party.children_ages.hint: Ask when children > 0 and ages are unknown and the price or hotel policy depends on age (infant fare, child bed, kids club).

dates.nights.hint: Ask when only a month is known and the total changes by more than sensitivity.price_delta_pct between 5 and 10 nights.

budget_rub.max.hint: Ask when the user said «недорого» or nothing fits, and the cheapest and comfort variants differ a lot. Never ask on the first turn when a result can be shown.
